limitations: Only unweighted cocktail-party graphs with 2, 3, 4, or 5 antipodal pairs, centered graph-distance balls, counting measure, and real strong ell^2; no extension beyond this finite range or to other exponents is proved.
scientific_integrity: The finite certificate is exhaustive for the stated graph sizes and checks spectral domination by exact integer inequalities. Floating point generates candidate witnesses but does not determine acceptance. No absolute publication-priority or external validation claim is made.
title: Sharp maximal norms and an antipodal-pair transition in cocktail-party graphs
